reason.reason: Shared Cargo target reused package outputs across copied paths whose source mtimes predated the previous build. All shared-target verification records and candidate artifacts are superseded by isolated-target rebuilds before benchmarking.

method.bootstrap: percentile paired bootstrap, whole before/after pairs resampled together
method.noise_floor: max(abs(A/A CI95 endpoints)), matched fixture/stage/config/baseline/counter scope
method.retention: all observations retained; incomplete/failed series excluded; no trimming or warmup removal

reviewed_conclusion: No candidate passed the adoption gate: gain >=5%, CI95 lower >0, gain above matched A/A noise. No mainline source change adopted.

reviewed_decisions.name: 2. Меньше вызовов metadata
reviewed_decisions.evidence: Мелкие файлы: E2E +3.70%, CI [-1.13; 8.45]; чтение +2.58%, CI [-3.26; 8.28]. В стадии чтения io_other_ops снизились на 25%, но выигрыш времени и CPU не доказан. Mixed +5.12% ниже шума A/A 9.36%.

reviewed_decisions.name: 3. Неблокирующее пополнение очереди
reviewed_decisions.evidence: Мелкие файлы: +1.28%, CI [-0.99; 3.37]. На startup-tree общее время хуже на 1.71%; первый BundlePlan 8.93 → 15.76 мс. Начальное окно 32 × readers сохранено.

reviewed_decisions.name: 4. Два буфера чтения крупных файлов
reviewed_decisions.evidence: BigFiles: +0.30% при росте CPU cycles на 17.12%, CPU time на 16.10%, RSS на 4.26%. Несжимаемые данные: −4.62%. Автоматический conditional_startup отклонён: source worker запускается после первого BundlePlan, причинной связи нет.

reviewed_decisions.name: 5. Предзагрузка префиксов средних файлов
reviewed_decisions.evidence: Medium-prefix: +4.81%, CI [0.24; 8.90], при шуме A/A 10.63%. Первая серия +8.43%, подтверждение +1.10%. Изолированное чтение +0.61%, его CPU cycles выросли на 2.84%. Mixed около +5% ниже шума A/A 9.36%.

limitations: Windows localhost measurements are not physical-NIC or Linux performance measurements.
Source/output use the same E: volume; cache state and other applications are uncontrolled. Verification can warm later samples.
All first samples and outliers remain included. Bootstrap intervals are exploratory, with no multiple-comparison correction.
E2E CPU/cycles/RSS cover sender+receiver together. Isolated file-stage CPU is separate; stage RSS is lifetime highwater.
Time to first bundle measures BundlePlan readiness, not first network byte or acknowledgement.
Overlapping stage durations are not an additive decomposition. Compressed payload bytes are not exact archive size.
Passing Linux reruns do not erase the initial intermittent failure or establish its root cause.
The four patches are independent experiments against one baseline, not a combined or mainline implementation.
Known hardware provenance is 32 logical CPUs and E: capacity/free space recorded in experiment.json. CPU model and storage type were not obtained; CIM access was denied.
